'''Sigil''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ORS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> in the [[Sigil system/Legends|Sigil system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> An ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Terrak Morrhage]], originally trained on the planet Sigil, learning the scientific arts of the Sith and deliberately ingesting [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] to gain immunity.<ref name="ORS" />
